cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Recruit Them Twice
cards.instruction: Recruit them to your side, then reveal that the side, goal, or conflict is not what it first appeared to be.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Join my campaign to save the club garden.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Our extension plan. The one we both signed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We know the opposition's weaknesses. Will you join the honest version?
